
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/qq21497936/p/19906838" title="发布于 2026-04-22 11:35">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">深度学习开发笔记（一）：跨平台纯C++训练和推理框架LibTorch介绍、开发环境搭建和Demo</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1>前言</h1>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  为了让一些应用具备部署的应用就具有训练能力，又为了减少其依赖能力，设想事兼具性能和训练，于是开始研究深度学习模型推理方法。<br>  本文旨在寻找一个训练解决方案，其能在 PC、Linux、ARM 板卡（如树莓派、瑞芯微、英伟达 Jetson）上都能直接C++训练、训练+推理一体、跨平台、不依赖 Python、轻量、可移植的深度学习框架。<br>  通过研究，发现LibTorch（PyTroch C++前端）可以满足。</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="LibTorchPyTroch_C_7"></a>LibTorch（PyTroch C++前端）</h1>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_8"></a>简介</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  在深度学习开发中，Python 凭借简洁的语法成为训练首选，但在工业部署、嵌入式设备、跨平台原生应用场景中，Python环境依赖、性能损耗、兼容性问题成为瓶颈。我们目前需要一套无 Python 依赖、支持多平台、可训练可推理的纯 C++ 解决方案（直接融合到应用中，进入工厂/专家模式可进行训练）。<br>  LibTorch作为 PyTorch 的官方C++前端，完美解决了这一痛点：它继承了 PyTorch的核心能力，支持模型定义、前向传播、反向传播、训练优化、模型保存加载全流程，且原生兼容Windows、Linux、ARM等全平台，真正实现 “一次编码，多端运行”。<br>  本系列将从零开始，带你使用 LibTorch 实现纯 C++ 深度学习模型训练和推理。</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_12"></a>核心优势</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<ul>
<li>纯 C++ 全栈能力：无需 Python，C++ 完成训练 + 推理，零环境依赖，直接集成到原生项目；</li>
<li>跨平台原生支持：完美支持 Windows (x86)、Linux (x86/ARM)、树莓派、Jetson 等硬件；</li>
<li>高性能加速：支持 CPU 多核、ARM NEON、CUDA GPU 加速，性能远超手写 C++ 网络；</li>
<li>PyTorch生态兼容：API 与 Python 版 PyTorch 高度一致，学习成本极低，模型可互通；</li>
<li>工业级稳定：广泛用于自动驾驶、物联网、客户端 AI 等生产环境。</li>


</ul>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_18"></a>下载地址</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  平台版本：https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/<br>  Windows：选择 LibTorch (C++/Windows)<br>  Linux x86：选择 LibTorch (C++/Linux)<br>  ARM 平台：可直接编译或下载预编译包</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="vs2017x64_23"></a>注意（这里是否准确，根据运行结果，不准确了，使用到了vs2017x64了）</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  这里官方全程没有写其是依赖VS2019/VS2022，只说了用msvc，没有提及msvc的版本，是社区踩坑找到的，我们基于前人的总结如下：</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<ul>
<li>2.1+ 最新版：VS2022 MSVC v143 编译（后续看入坑三，这里会有细节需要深究了）</li>
<li>2.0 及更早：VS2019 MSVC v142 编译（后续看入坑三，这里会有细节需要深究了）</li>


</ul>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_27"></a>版本选择</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  LibTorch1.13.1：其是最后一个VS2019编译的版本，这个有点坑，实际最后可以MSVC2016X64，所以可能是兼容的。<br>  Qt5.12.7：Qt开始支持VS2019编译的版本是Qt5.15开始，这里5.12.7是笔者多次踩坑后最终运行成功的。<br>  安装VS2017的选v141（v142是vs2019的编译器，v143是vs2022的编译）器）。</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">&nbsp;</div>

<span class="token macro property"><span class="token directive-hash">#<span class="token directive keyword">endif
<span class="token punctuation">}
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="v100_215"></a>工程模板v1.0.0</h1>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202604/1971530-20260422113501008-103933247.png" class="lazyload"></p>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="_221"></a>入坑</h1>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="parameterlistxxxx_222"></a>入坑一：报错“parameter-listxxxx“</h2>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_223"></a>问题</h3>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202604/1971530-20260422113501357-223361126.png" class="lazyload"></p>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="1_226"></a>尝试1：切换版本</h3>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  经过研究，网上说是2.0.0是vs2019，实际上2.0.0是vs2022了。<br>  下降版本，最后一个vs2019版本是libtorch1.13.0。<br>  QObject::slots() 这个成员函数，确实是 Qt 6 新增的 API，Qt5 完全没有！</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="2_230"></a>尝试2：只能细看</h3>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  发现是代码就没这个函数：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202604/1971530-20260422113501341-2027901364.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  进一步挖掘，感觉是污染版本了，libtorch使用slots()与qt认为是自己的SLOT()宏冲突。</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_235"></a>解决</h3>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  使用下面的代码解决：</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<pre><code class="prism language-cpp"><span class="token comment">// 固定模板，顺序绝对不能改
<span class="token macro property"><span class="token directive-hash">#<span class="token directive keyword">undef <span class="token expression">slots          <span class="token comment">// 先干掉Qt全局slots宏污染
<span class="token macro property"><span class="token directive-hash">#<span class="token directive keyword">include <span class="token string">&lt;torch/torch.h&gt;
<span class="token macro property"><span class="token directive-hash">#<span class="token directive keyword">define <span class="token macro-name">slots <span class="token expression">Q_SLOTS  <span class="token comment">// 恢复Qt原本的slots槽宏
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="protobuf_243"></a>入坑二：报错无法打开输入protobuf</h2>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_244"></a>问题</h3>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202604/1971530-20260422113501284-1078557559.png" class="lazyload"></p>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_247"></a>原因</h3>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  正常来说LIBS += -l，就不用带库前三位是lib的了：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202604/1971530-20260422113501281-1291698006.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  这里这次要带？？根据提示报错，其是打不开protobuf，不是libprotobuf。</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_252"></a>解决</h3>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<pre><code class="prism language-cpp">LIBS <span class="token operator">+= <span class="token operator">-llibprotobuf
</span></span></code></pre>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  惯性思维有点坑。</p>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="Process_creashed_257"></a>入坑三：运行就“Process creashed”</h2>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_258"></a>问题</h3>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202604/1971530-20260422113501064-1324624895.png" class="lazyload"><br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202604/1971530-20260422113501241-653201147.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="1_261"></a>尝试1：定位具体代码</h3>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202604/1971530-20260422113501317-1411538111.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  考虑是否msvc的版本于是更换1.13，2.0.0，2.11.1，未发现问题。<br>  （后续补充：是参数1.0，2.0和3.0f的问题，导致混合了，但是工程没保存，这里以后再说了）<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202604/1971530-20260422113501022-1500519498.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="2exe_268"></a>尝试2：从exe运行下手</h3>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  思路跑exe，如果加载错误就会报错，逐一添加：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202604/1971530-20260422113501347-119996652.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  依提示添加库，一是证明了添加成功了，二是证明了跑不起与库版本无关。<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202604/1971530-20260422113501053-525845513.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  至此而过，确认不是依赖库问题。<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202604/1971530-20260422113501043-179341463.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  把重点放到代码调用上：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202604/1971530-20260422113501063-511094293.png" class="lazyload"><br>  查询CPU是否支持AVX，AVX2也可能崩溃出现这个问题，如下：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202604/1971530-20260422113501419-1462350647.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  不是问题。</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="3_284"></a>尝试3：版本混战</h3>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  Qt5.12，5.14，5.15各自遍历搭配libtorch1.13.1，2.0.0，2.11.0，发现仍然如此。</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="42_286"></a>尝试4：无意发现2个参数的不报错</h3>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  经过进一步论证，发现Qt5.12.x+msvc2017x64+libtorch-1.13.1可以。<br>  同样部署到Qt5.15.2+msvc2019x64+libtorch几个版本还是不行。</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_289"></a>解决</h3>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  最终定了Qt5.12.2+msvc2017x64+libtorch1.13.1是可以的。<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202604/1971530-20260422113501096-1938035989.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="1_293"></a>思考1</h3>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  默认就是msvc的版本不兼容，说只支持msvc2019x64/msvc2022x64，现在1.13.1可以msvc2017x64，这里不深究了（有兴趣，读者可继续）。</p>


</div>

</div>
